}}'''Edelle Gaelin''' is the [[Wisdom]] of [[Watch Hill]].

==Appearance==
She has long, gray hair that she wears braided in the [[Two Rivers]] style.

==History==
She is almost old enough to be [[Milla al'Azar]]'s mother.

She has held the office of Wisdom for a long time. The other Wisdoms of the Two Rivers, excepting [[Daise Congar]], appear to follow her lead.

She does not have the [[Talent]] of [[Listening to the Wind]].

==Activities==
She brings some of her dried-apple tarts to "[[Perrin Aybara|Lord Perrin]]" as a gift. The people of the Two Rivers wish to assess whether or not Perrin is going to be right for the region.

She is disappointed that she did not get the post of Wisdom in [[Emond's Field]] after [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s departure.

She, [[Milla al'Azar]], Daise Congar, and [[Elwinn Taron]] meet with [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile]] to discuss events in the Two Rivers. They find talking to Faile easier because of the unexpected effect Perrin's ''[[ta'veren]]'' ability has on their resolve. Edelle comments on there having been no rain for months.
